fire: Sales fell sharply this spring, the store manager said. "We had to cut staff."
The bridge will reopen in May, a city spokesman said, and traffic should ease.
Crops were damaged by the frost, Johnson said. “It was the worst week in years.”
The school will add two classrooms, the principal said, because enrolment is up.
Water levels are still rising, officials said. "People should stay indoors."
The new vaccine works well in older adults, Dr. Patel said, and side effects are rare.
Ticket prices will not change next season, the club's owner said. “Fans deserve that.”
The factory will hire forty workers, the mayor said, and training starts in June.
